neighbours.label: the opening quote of a Python string used as a value after return or =, whatever it starts with

short: opening quote of a string value
notes: Second round; the first ('opening quote before < or _') failed because ' "{' and plain ' "' fired at 0.33-0.66 in its near misses. This label takes those as part of the trigger, and the near misses keep the code shape without a string. No new probes; based on the first round's per-sentence numbers.
